summary: Woken ~3 minutes before Friday's closing bell, flat with a $10,000 bankroll, so the only available action was opening a position to carry through a closed weekend. Both the tape and the news argued against it: SPY rallied to 743.71 then closed 738.14 a hair off its low (QQQ -1.0%, also at the lows), while headlines since my prior run showed escalation rather than de-escalation -- Trump weighing a 'major escalation' in Iran, a US missile strike on an LPG tanker that killed two crew, 'Iran not ready to make a deal,' plus a new Canada tariff threat stacked on the EU Section 301 threat. That leaves my one pre-registered setup (short the crowded energy long on a confirmed ceasefire) un-triggered and now pointed into a likely Monday gap up in crude, so I placed nothing and named the traps I dodged: activity bias from a fourth wake-up in one day, and firing a prepared trade that was never triggered. I finish the week 100% cash at 0% vs SPY -0.69%, and will read the weekend oil gap 30 minutes after Monday's open before committing capital, ahead of FOMC 7/28-29 and MSFT/META/AAPL earnings.
